definition: The surface of a building element that faces toward the space, unit, or volume being bounded or defined.
The surface of a building element that faces away from the space, unit, or volume being bounded or defined.
A plane located midway between two opposing surfaces of a building element, representing its geometric centre through its thickness.
The surface of a building element that forms its upper or top-facing boundary.
The surface of a building element that forms its lower or underside boundary.
A surface of a building element that faces the exterior of a building, structure, or other enclosing construction.
A two-dimensional geometric extent forming part or all of the boundary of a three-dimensional object or spatial extent.
A flat two-dimensional geometric construct of theoretically unlimited extent that may be used to define or derive a boundary position.
